notes.title: Update Description for Drunk Or Dead 2
notes.content:
We're excited to announce a new update for Drunk Or Dead 2 with the following improvements:

Balance Adjustments:

Simplified difficulty modes for levels, making it easier to navigate and enjoy the game.
Sobering up is now slowed down, with the speed depending on the difficulty level chosen.
New Features:

The Online Bar is now accessible after completing the first mission. Connect and strategize with other players in this virtual hangout.
Bug Fixes:

Various fixes in locations and player mechanics to enhance the overall gameplay experience.
Dive back in and experience the improved balance and new features. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to refine and expand the game. Enjoy!

notes.title: Balancing the Easy Mode
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've noticed that some of you are finding it challenging to play in Easy Mode. Our current tools aren't quite up to the task of creating a balanced and enjoyable experience.

Right now, our main goal is to develop a new balancing system. We want to make Easy Mode fun and accessible for all players.

Thank you for your patience and understanding as we work on these improvements.

Best regards,
The Development Team

notes.title: Drunk Or Dead 2 VR Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Step into the wild, post-apocalyptic world of Drunk Or Dead 2, where surviving a zombie outbreak is just another reason to party!

[previewyoutube=6sEVl8bbATA;full][/previewyoutube]

As a survivor, you'll embark on a hilarious, action-packed adventure, tackling bizarre and challenging missions. Whether it's battling hordes of zombies or brewing moonshine, every task is designed to test your wit, grit, and ability to think outside the box.

Drunk Or Dead 2 hits Steam Early Access on June 14th! Add us to your wishlist now and don't miss out on the discount!

How Can I Find Out More?
Join our Discord! Chat with our dev team and fellow fans about Drunk Or Dead 2, get the latest updates, and share your wildest ideas. Follow us on Twitter and Instagram to stay in the loop!

notes.title: Are you folks ready for a crazy zombie carnival?
notes.content:
Folks, if you're ready for a crazy zombie carnival, you definitely need to dive into the world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399850/Drunk_Or_Dead_2_Prologue/]Drunk Or Dead 2 Prologue! [/url]

Here you'll find not only intense shootouts with the undead but also cool stuff like unconventional weaponry, fortified shelters, and team play for survival. Yeah, the zombies are serious, but humor and tension, folks, that's our jam! Get into the action, grab your weapons, and show how you can be "drunk and alive"

notes.title: Join the Drunk Or Dead2 stream right now!
notes.content:
Hey party people! Welcome to our latest video as we take on the shooter game Drunk Or Dead2! Get ready for a wild ride full of crazy twists and turns as we dive headfirst into this indie game with tequila, absinthe, and other drinks!

And if you're a fan of all things absurd, you'll definitely want to sit through to the end.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your VR headset and get ready to party like it's the end of the world. It's such a greate party, and you're invited!
